requirements.statement: Humans can locate code, knowledge, assurance, pending checks, and audit evidence from one entry point
Non-trivial changes express Requirement, Claim, Evidence, Human Check, scope, and uncertainty relationships
Release readiness fails closed for missing, stale, failed, N/A, or human-incomplete MUST support
Repository relationships can be indexed without making the index a second source of truth
Explanation adapts by domain without weakening assurance, and agent traces remain sanitized and coverage-aware
V2 template verification remains compatible while harness maintenance has exact-run RED evidence

evidence_requirements.description: Integration self-test requires all entry-point and folder-role files

claims.statement: Malformed references, asymmetric Human Check links, and unsupported MUST Claims are rejected
